description: You are the procurement manager at GAEC JOULIN. Log in to Ekylibre at http://demo.ekylibre.farm:3000 using admin@ekylibre.org / 12345678. Three agricultural input suppliers have delivered goods in January 2024 and their invoices must be entered in the farm accounting system. Record a purchase invoice dated 2024-01-20 from each of the 3 distinct suppliers already present in the system — covering seeds, fertilizer, and phytosanitary products respectively. Once all 3 invoices are recorded, validate at least 2 of them to generate the accounting journal entries.
